name: How much does a curbless shower conversion cost in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: How much does a curbless shower conversion cost in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a curbless shower conversion in the Bay Area varies significantly based on factors like the size of the shower, chosen materials (tile, fixtures), and the complexity of plumbing modifications. Typically, you can expect costs to range from $8,000 to $20,000 or more. This includes demolition, waterproofing, sloping the subfloor, new drainage, tiling, and installation of new fixtures. A detailed on-site consultation is essential to receive an accurate estimate tailored to your specific bathroom and design preferences.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs for a curbless shower in the Bay Area typically range from $8,000 to $20,000+, depending on size, materials, and plumbing complexity.
